## unification

Unification combines two values into the one value that satisfies both. Writing a field twice unifies the two values. A conflict is an error. The operator is `&`.

## definition

A definition is a field whose name starts with `#`. It describes a shape that other values are checked against.

## constraint

A constraint restricts the values a field may take, such as `int` or `>=1`.
